results.detail: Settled ROW_NUMBER: PARTITION BY ft.gen_transtotalamount, so.gen_bankname, so.gen_bankaccountnumber, so.gen_branch ORDER BY ft.gen_ActualExecutionDate asc, WHERE RowNum = 1; Gen_standingorderId is not in the partition, so several orders (e.g. different customer accounts) with the same amount + bank details yield one update per run; after an order is marked it leaves the population and the next one surfaces in a later run (if its transaction is still in Gen_ftCurrentYear). Ties nondeterministic. Extra nuance: partition uses the raw (unpadded) so.gen_bankaccountnumber while matching uses the 12-digit padded form, so orders whose account numbers differ only in leading zeros fall in different partitions.
